title: A local whisper server plugged into the repo via MCP, recording transcripts straight into the SRS container (2026-11-04)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: So, my bigger plan has always been to set up a separate TSS format for managing transcripts. But, what if we had a local whisper server that we can also plug into the repo via mcp. Then I can record transcripts directly into the srs container. This should just work as a package? And then a runnable container that could connect and stream in the transcription?
